tv.changelog: Unified the TV subtitle system around one central config (UnifiedSubtitleConfig) synced across TV, Phone, and Google Cloud Backup, with grouped embedded video subtitles, a live timing overlay bar, one-click Arabic translation, and strict search filtering. Added direct Install on TV support from Phone, upgraded the in-app update dialog for the main v2 update channel with D-Pad focus and Downloader code 3213660, and improved safe cache maintenance.

phone.changelog: Updated the Browser Sites grid with MEEDX WEB, Cinemana, YTS, and TorrentGalaxy first plus long-press site reordering. Streamlined External Addons on Phone by removing the heavy stream-addon list and Paste/Search controls while adding direct Install on TV confirmation for Curated Addons and Stremio links. Cleaned up Settings titles and single-line Cloud Backup action buttons, added subtitle config to Google Cloud Backup, and upgraded the in-app update popup for the main v2 update channel.
